name: Dimethyl
aliases: fumaric acid, (E)-but-2-enedioic acid dimethyl ester, 1,2-bis(methoxycarbonyl)-trans-ethylene, BG-12, dimethyl (E)-butenedioate, dimethyl trans-ethylenedicarboxylate, fumaric acid, dimethyl ester, trans-butenedioic acid dimethyl ester
summary: Dimethyl fumarate (DMF) is the methyl ester of fumaric acid. Dimethyl fumarate combined with three other fumaric acid esters (FAEs) is solely licensed in Germany as an oral therapy for psoriasis (brand name Fumaderm).S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as a treatment option for adults with relapsing multiple sclerosis (brand name Tecfidera).
